maintenance_led.reason: MRO distribution of bearings, pumps, safety and industrial supplies plus repair services keep customers' existing facilities and equipment running.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private industrial firms in manufacturing, oil and gas, agriculture and construction, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Acquisitions are a historical part of growth, but it mainly grows organically through distribution, with occasional deals.

mission_critical.reason: Mostly distributed MRO products and supplies from third-party brands; customers can switch suppliers fairly easily, despite some embedded supply chain services.

notes: DXP has made many acquisitions historically; serial-acquirer and switching-cost judgments are somewhat uncertain.
